purpose: Freeze leadership, dependency, action-baseline, timing and interim-review rules before future outcome joins.

leadership.rule: A leadership call is eligible only when its dimension, metric, window, settlement convention, threshold or dead-band and confirmation mode were frozen before outcome observability.
leadership.historical_rule: Do not use this contract to reopen or relabel W28-W31 owner outcomes.

rotation_separation.rule: Relative strength and positive absolute performance do not constitute rotation unless the existing rotation owner separately confirms breadth and transmission requirements.

dependency_clusters.rule: Labels whose resolution depends on the same underlying observation count as one material decision divergence.

action_policy.wait_deduplication_rule: WAIT is not a separate benchmark when it is identical to FRAMEWORK_FROZEN_ACTION.
action_policy.neutral_rule: NEUTRAL is allowed only when a valid benchmark is instantiated and the measured utility difference is inside a preregistered dead-band.
action_policy.no_permission_event_rule: BLOCKED unless the evaluation contract explicitly defines a mature no-event horizon.

regime_distinctness.rule: Two rows count as distinct regimes only when an existing owner changes a controlled regime family, rotation state or leadership dimension. Renaming free-text labels does not create a new regime.

incremental_value.unit: temporally valid row where AATA changes a material decision interpretation beyond the existing owner audit and the change is independently reproduced

kill_checks: no independently reproducible material decision divergence
no measurable incremental value beyond existing owners
action lane still has no benchmarked variance
